purpose: Check whether the 40-turn benchmark score carries over to new wording. Its earlier misses guided the book lookup repairs, so it measures the targeted cases rather than new questions.
design: Keep each first question and expected answer, and reword every follow-up without changing its meaning, its pronouns or its source lines. The rewordings were written before either fixture was rerun.
review_method: A reply counts when it conveys the expected fact and its citation supports it in the requested scene, following the README review instructions. Abstentions count as misses.

reproduction.separate_check: OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 python -m model.chat_evaluation run --book --trace-passages --history generated --test-data data/oz_book_lookup_followup_check.jsonl --output <new-report>

separate_followup_check.use: Frozen before the follow-up repairs, with source ranges absent from earlier fixtures.

conclusion: The same 20 follow-ups score 20/20 as written and 11/20 when reworded, with 7 abstentions and 2 wrong answers. The separate follow-up check still scores 1/6 supported follow-ups. Report the separate check and the reworded score alongside the 40-turn result.
